testTitle: Real-time productivity dashboard
testDescription: Turn a report into a live web dashboard of crew output, speed, and cost that refreshes on an interval. Managers keep it open on a phone or browser to watch the day unfold.

testTitle: [Dashboard] Verify that the route loads and seeds a default board on first visit.
testDescription: With persisted boards cleared, the dashboard route auto-provisions a default board and paints at least one widget cell (PET-439).

testTitle: [Dashboard] Verify that the header shows a greeting and an Edit Widgets button.
testDescription: The header renders a time-of-day greeting as an h2 plus the Edit Widgets control. The greeting is matched loosely so it survives time and user drift.

testTitle: [Dashboard] Verify that the Edit Widgets button toggles the palette open and closed.
testDescription: Edit Widgets opens the palette and Done closes it. Closed is asserted as an item being not-visible, because the aside stays mounted at w-0.

testTitle: [Dashboard] Verify that the palette plus-button appends a widget to the active board.
testDescription: The palette plus button appends a widget to the active board. Click rather than drag: it hits the same onAdd path dnd-kit would, and synthetic DnD is flaky headless.

testTitle: [Dashboard] Verify that a new widget persists and survives a full page reload.
testDescription: A widget added through the palette is still painted after a full page reload, proving the server-backed board store round-trips.

testTitle: Map-based dashboard
testDescription: Show a live map of labor, equipment, and productivity by field, drawn from the field boundaries captured in setup. Useful for seeing where crews are and how each field is progressing.

testTitle: Cost-versus-price analysis
testDescription: Compare accumulating labor cost against the crop's market price to decide whether to keep harvesting, stop, or move fields. This is the owner's profitability view. Parked for Anthony (Cost Accounting off).

testTitle: Daily notification
testDescription: Schedule any report to email a recipient at a set time each day, for example who showed up in the field. The same report engine that feeds dashboards feeds these emails.

testTitle: Dashboard link sharing
testDescription: Share a live dashboard's web link with managers so they can open it in any browser or pin it on a phone. No app or login flow is needed beyond the link.

testTitle: Season-over-season comparison
testDescription: Compare results across seasons or years for the same field or crop to judge yield and productivity trends. This is the historical analysis the captured data enables.

testTitle: Report generation and export
testDescription: Run any of the system's reports with parameters and send the output to screen, printer, file, or Excel, the everyday analysis and payroll-review surface. The payroll summary and the meal-exceptions report are the most used.
